race.description: Taste Of Wa - Kids Eat Free In Beau Rivage Ffa Ms Pace
race.comment: PENNY BLACK NZ (4) is a smart mare who looks ready to win after placing in her last three outings here, the last two coming in Listed races. Draws lower than she did last week and drops to a distance where her record is strong. Race fit now and could break through. The form of EASTBRO CHRISSY (1) may look to have tapered off but she has copped some wide barriers of late and was held up last start. Much better served by the ace draw and she won the last time she started from there. LITTLE DARLING (2) gets her best draw of the campaign so far and is a two-time third-up winner so may be ready to show her best. HARRISON JOHN NZ (12) had no luck last start but was beaten only 3.5m when resuming at Listed level prior so is worth another chance.
